description:
Outcome: Gardeners sign in with emailed one-time links and contact details remain coordinator-only, from owner conversation and brief.md / Constraints.
Scope: Expiring secure single-use links, atomic token consumption, sessions/logout, rate limits, non-enumerating request responses, trusted-operator provisioning of the coordinator role and ownership authorization. Excludes: passwords and public coordinator signup.
Acceptance: A valid link signs in the intended account once; expired or replayed links fail; gardeners cannot access other households' data or contact details, or perform coordinator actions.
Behaviour: Accessible plain-language phone screens cover request/loading, delivery failure, expiry and resend; do not leak account existence, tokens or secrets.
Verification: Authentication, authorization, replay/concurrency, rate-limit and session tests using a fake email provider. Prerequisites: T-001. Assumptions: selected email adapter is shared with the digest; one verified account per household.
title: Secure passwordless access
